name: What kind of paint do you use for kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinets, we primarily use durable, high-quality paints specifically designed for cabinets and high-traffic areas. These paints offer excellent adhesion, resistance to chipping and scratching, and a smooth, washable finish. We often recommend acrylic or alkyd enamel paints for their longevity and aesthetic appeal, ensuring a beautiful result for your San Francisco or Sausalito kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use durable, high-quality acrylic or alkyd enamel paints designed for cabinets to ensure a lasting finish.
